title: Renewal Orchestra: Health Signal Mapping & Action Grid
content:
Purpose:
This is a working scoring worksheet ("Renewal Orchestra") intended to centralize disparate adoption signals into a single, weighted customer health score and an action grid for renewals. Goal is to produce a reproducible numeric score + clear automatic playbook trigger per customer tier.

Quick summary of approach:
- Collect ~12 orthogonal signals (product usage, latency to first value, feature adoption, billing lead indicators, support friction, integration depth, NPS/CSAT trends, exec engagement, recent incidents, policy/compliance flags, training completions, and contract churn risk).
- Normalize each signal to 0-100, apply team-defined weights, compute weighted average health (0-100).
- Map raw health bands to 3 operational tiers (Green/Yellow/Red) with templated playbook actions.
- Capture manual override and confidence score for signals derived from partial data.

Field definitions (columns for the sheet):
- customer_id: canonical customer id (string)
- customer_name: short name
- tier: commercial tier (trial / small / mid / enterprise)
- last_billing_activity: days since last invoice
- monthly_active_users_pct: current MAU as % of committed seats (0-200)
- key_feature_pct: percent of customers hitting 3+ key features (0-100)
- avg_session_len_min: average session length in minutes (for debuggable products)
- kv_cache_hit_rate_pct: technical signal for inference workloads (0-100)
- api_error_rate_pct_last_30d: error rate as percent of requests (0-100)
- tickets_per_1000_units_30d: normalized support load
- exec_touch_days: days since last executive touch (null allowed)
- nps_trend_90d: delta NPS over previous 90d (can be negative)
- compliance_flags: yes/no (string)
- renewal_date: ISO date
- raw_signal_vector_hash: internal debug id
- score_notes: free text for CS to annotate

Normalizations & scoring rules (working):
- All signals normalized to 0-100 with documented transforms in helper sheet. Example:
  - monthly_active_users_pct_norm = clamp(monthly_active_users_pct, 0, 200) / 2 -> 0..100
  - api_error_rate_norm = 100 - min(api_error_rate_pct_last_30d*1.5, 100) (errors penalize score)
  - exec_touch_norm = if exec_touch_days <= 14 -> 100, else if <=45 -> 70, else if <=90 -> 40, else -> 10
  - compliance_flag_norm -> 0 if YES, else 90

Default weight proposal (sum to 100):
- usage (MAU %): 20
- key_feature_pct: 15
- kv_cache_hit_rate_pct: 8
- session_length: 5
- api_error_rate: 15
- tickets volume: 6
- exec_touch: 10
- nps_trend: 8
- billing_activity (recency): 6
- compliance flags: 7

Weighted health score calculation (example pseudo):
- health = round(sum(norm_signal_i * weight_i)/100) -> integer 0..100
- confidence = min(100, 100 - (#signals_missing * 8) ) (simple heuristic)

Health bands and operational mapping (suggested):
- 80 - 100 = Green (Healthy) => autopilot checks, standard renewal cadence, NPS invite campaign 30d before renewal
- 60 - 79 = Yellow (Watch) => Assign CSM "watch" tag, schedule product deep-dive, pre-emptive enablement, reduce risk by offering onboarding credit if adoption under target
- 0 - 59 = Red (At-risk) => Immediate 1:1, escalate to AM/SDR/Engineer depending on failure mode, open incident review if technical, prepare commercial remediation (discount or services)

Action grid (examples of triggers mapped to recommended playbook):
- Trigger: api_error_rate > 2% for 7d + usage decline > 15% -> Playbook: "Technical Stabilization" (SRE & Solutions Eng ping, pause major rollouts, PRR)
- Trigger: exec_touch_days > 60 + nps_trend < -5 -> Playbook: "Executive Re-engagement" (AM outreach, tailored QBR, roadmap alignment)
- Trigger: billing lapse (last_billing_activity > 45 days) -> Playbook: "Billing Recovery" (Finance + CSM sync, offer payment plan)
- Trigger: compliance_flag == YES -> Playbook: "Compliance Escalation" (Legal + Security review, private deployment offer)

Example rows (for copy/paste into sheet):
- cust-001, Acme AI, enterprise, 10, 120, 85, 42, 78, 0.4, 2.3, 22, +4, NO, 2026-01-15, hash-xx, "Customer expanding; watch error trend"
- cust-009, SkyRetail, mid, 65, 48, 30, 15, 55, 2.6, 8.1, 80, -6, NO, 2025-09-12, hash-yy, "Churn signal: exec cold"

Playbook templates (snippets to paste into CS system):
- Technical Stabilization (trigger owners: SRE/SE/CSM):
  Objective: Contain outage impact, restore API SLA, and stabilize feature experience.
  Steps:
   1) Open incident channel, assign SRE lead
   2) Pause customer rollouts and advise on mitigation flags
   3) Run targeted performance traces, provide ETA within 48h
   4) Postmortem + preventive plan, schedule follow-up QBR within 30 days

- Executive Re-engagement (owner: AM/CS lead):
  Objective: Rebuild trust, identify missed business outcomes, negotiate remediation if needed.
  Steps:
   1) 2-week executive touch cadence, confirm top 3 priorities
   2) Deliver tailored ROI/usage digest and near-term roadmap relevance
   3) Offer workshop (free) to jumpstart feature adoption

Open questions / items for product/analytics:
- Do we include model quality signals (generation hallucination rates) as a first-class metric? needs instrumentation plan from serving-runtime team. (tracked JIRA: CS-1428)
- Should weights be tiered (e.g., enterprise cares more about exec_touch/compliance than small accounts)? propose tier-weight matrix in next iteration.
- Data freshness SLA: what is acceptable lag for each signal? recommend daily for usage, hourly for error rates, weekly for NPS.

TODOs (near-term):
- [ ] Build helper sheet that contains exact normalization formulas and sample calculations (owner: Priya)
- [ ] Wire api_error_rate and kv_cache_hit_rate into daily ETL (owner: Diego)
- [ ] Draft templated messages for each playbook (owner: Nina)
- [ ] Review weight matrix with Sales leadership by 2025-03-01

Notes on manual override and governance:
- CSMs may flag a "manual_health_override" field and provide a short reason. Overrides require head of CS sign-off for +/ - 15 points.
- All score changes must be auditable; store raw signal vector and normalization version hash in raw_signal_vector_hash.

Appendix: shorthand for internal use
- "Orchestra" = the end-to-end health scoring pipeline (signals -> normalize -> weight -> score -> playbook)
- "Conductor" = automated rule engine that schedules triggers and notifies owners

Revision history log (brief):
- v0.1 2024-11-15 initial draft (Aisha)
- v0.2 2024-12-18 added technical signals & weights (Diego)
- v0.3 2025-02-20 adjusted bands and added confidence heuristic (Priya)

End of sheet.

(Working doc: treat as iterative; please paste new examples into the bottom of the sheet instead of editing earlier rows — historical trace is useful.)
